prompt.generated_prompt_string: A casual vertical direct-flash Y2K bedroom snapshot of an adult woman with dark-brown hair in a high messy bun, loose face-framing strands, soft fresh makeup, rosy cheeks, mauve lips, and a gentle closed-mouth smile. She wears an oversized cream ribbed-knit sweater with a wide folded collar. Frame a centered eye-level bust portrait; her shoulders are slightly raised in a cozy posture, her head tilts gently to the viewer's left, and she looks directly at the camera. Behind her is a white bedroom wall densely covered with generic non-readable magazine-style imagery, abstract photos, and stickers—no legible text, recognizable poster art, logos, labels, or watermark. Use direct on-camera flash at approximately 5500K, with hard frontal light and a distinct hard drop shadow behind her head and shoulders. Smartphone or point-and-shoot 28–35mm equivalent, f/4–f/5.6, 1/60s, ISO 400, cool flash balance, natural skin texture, and relatively deep background focus.
prompt.negative_prompt: explicit, nsfw, overly revealing, minor, childlike appearance, sexual pose, readable text, recognizable poster artwork, logo, label, watermark, plastic skin, waxy, over-smooth, over-saturated, airbrushed, HDR look, extra fingers, deformed

reference_elements.prompt_instructions: No reference asset is required. Optional approved-adult face and wardrobe references may be attached; preserve adult identity, high messy bun, cream ribbed sweater, and direct-flash framing when supplied. A background reference can inform collage density and palette only; do not reproduce readable text, logos, or recognizable poster artwork.

changes: Changed young-woman wording to an explicitly adult woman and excluded childlike appearance.
Preserved the knit sweater, messy bun, flash setup, cozy pose, and dense Y2K collage-wall direction.
Prevented reproduction of readable text, logos, and recognizable poster artwork.
